description: An engineering school has a bridge building competition where students must build as many beam bridges and truss bridges as they can using Popsicle sticks and glue. A beam bridge requires 30 Popsicle sticks and 5 units of glue while a truss bridge requires 50 Popsicle sticks and 8 units of glue. Each team has at most 600 Popsicle sticks and 100 units of glue. In addition, each team can build at most 5 truss bridges and the number of beam bridges must be larger than the number of truss bridges. If a beam bridge can hold 40 grams and a truss bridge can hold 60 grams, how many of each bridge should a team build to maximize the total mass that can be supported?

TotalPopsicleSticks.definition: Total number of Popsicle sticks available

PopsicleSticksPerBeamBridge.definition: Number of Popsicle sticks required to build one beam bridge

PopsicleSticksPerTrussBridge.definition: Number of Popsicle sticks required to build one truss bridge

GluePerBeamBridge.definition: Units of glue required to build one beam bridge

GluePerTrussBridge.definition: Units of glue required to build one truss bridge

MaxTrussBridges.definition: Maximum number of truss bridges that can be built

MassPerBeamBridge.definition: Mass that one beam bridge can hold

MassPerTrussBridge.definition: Mass that one truss bridge can hold

objective.description: "The goal is to maximize the total mass that can be supported by the beam and truss bridges built."

constraints.description: 30 times the number of beam bridges plus 50 times the number of truss bridges should not exceed the total available Popsicle sticks (600)
5 times the number of beam bridges plus 8 times the number of truss bridges should not exceed the total available glue (100)
The number of truss bridges built should not exceed 5
The number of beam bridges built must be strictly greater than the number of truss bridges built
The number of beam bridges built and the number of truss bridges built must be non-negative integers

BeamBridges.definition: Number of beam bridges built by the team

TrussBridges.definition: Number of truss bridges built by the team
